hypothesis.statement: The four fresh-seed joint task0 discordant timeouts (paired inits 8, 11, 12, 13) may share a preterminal manipulation-stage signature absent from their matched single-task successes.
hypothesis.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if all four joint timeout replays reach both frozen lift and transport predicates seen in validated positive controls; interpretation is invalid if any positive control fails a frozen predicate or replay-parity check.
hypothesis.interpretation_limit: Descriptive trace association only; no causal claim about interference, training, or simulator effects. This is not a progression gate.

source_hash_manifest.required_hash: SHA-256 for every required file, recorded before replay; hash mismatch or missing file is a hard stop

initialization_order: replay stored applied actions in source order

trace_checks.success: exact match to source summary and official env.check_success()

positive_controls.required: Every source-success trace must pass all replay checks; every positive must exhibit lift, transport, and terminal native placement; native placement must agree with official success on every replay step.

frozen_stage_predicates.lift: post-action bowl height >= post-wait initial bowl height + 0.03 m
frozen_stage_predicates.terminal_placement: native plate ontop predicate agrees with official env.check_success() at every step and is true terminally for each source-success trace

positive_controls.failure_rule: Any positive-control predicate or replay parity failure invalidates stage interpretation; stop without threshold changes.

selected_timeout_traces.matched_positive_controls: single task0 traces at the same four inits
selected_timeout_traces.frozen_interpretation: Compare event presence/order descriptively only after all positive controls validate; a timeout reaching both lift and transport falsifies the shared-omission hypothesis.

stop_conditions: SSH/source verification, source hashes, or runtime compatibility cannot be established
recorded start state or simulator/model arrays do not match the saved first_input evidence before action replay
positive controls fail any frozen stage predicate
GPU compute becomes active or GPU use is required
missing/duplicate/malformed trace or any non-finite/out-of-range action

execution_paths.creation_rule: Before any write, verify both paths are absent by authenticated read-only check, then create exclusively; never overwrite or reuse. Keep raw actions, traces, logs, videos, checkpoints, and data on the private host.

authorization_and_gates.historical_v3_parity_invalidation: unchanged; this is a new diagnostic version and does not repair or rewrite the historical result
authorization_and_gates.progression_gate: unchanged; this diagnostic cannot unlock Fold02 or eight-task work

transport_status.remote_process_state: unknown; no inference from transport failure
transport_status.next_remote_action: At most one authenticated read-only status/source-manifest attempt after checking the existing ControlMaster; do not restart or launch any workload.
